description:
When designing the Letras disc, Our goal was to keep the low weight and exquisite feeling of the rim brake version. To achieve this, we kept some elements that are non standard to all disc brake bikes. Skinny rear stays, 34mm head tube and a 1-1/8 straight steerer tube. this basically transitioned the beloved DNA of the original version into a modern platform. Fitting 32mm tires and disc brakes.

"Designed around a single word: Delight. Letras is an unpretentious bike with one clear goal—to give the rider the purest, most enjoyable sensation on a bike. In a world where climbing is measured in watts and gradients, we’ve taken the opposite approach, amplifying the indescribable joy of finding your rhythm on the ascent while syncing your body and mind with the environment."
